data.name: Ruben
data.gender_notes: Ruben is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ruben means 'son of Jacob' in Hebrew. He is the eldest son of Jacob and Leah. In the Old Testament, Ruben leads his brothers to go out and find food during the famine in Egypt. Later, he helps Joseph escape from Potiphar's wife and saves him from being thrown into a pit. The name Ruben carries the meaning “Son of Jacob” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Ruben usually hope their child will grow to embody son of jacob and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ruben belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Son of Jacob.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruben total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: רובן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: רובן הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'הנה בן ראובן אלוקים רואה'. הוא היה הבן הראשון של יעקב עם לאה, ואמו נתנה לו שם זה כי אמרה 'כי ראתה ה' בצרתי כי לא הוסיף לי בעלי בנים' (בראשית כט 32-33). ראובן היה גם אחד מלוחמי ישראל במדבר וקיבל חלק בארץ כנען. השם רובן משמש גם כביטוי לרעיון של אלוקים שרואה ומודע לכל מעשי בני האדם.

in_greek.name: Ρουβήν
in_greek.long_meaning: Ρουβήν είναι το ελληνικό ισοδύναμο του εβραϊκού ονόματος רובן, που σημαίνει 'Ιδού παις Θεός εώρακεν' (Ιδού, ο Θεός είδε). Στο βιβλίο της Γενεσεως, ο Ρουβήν ήταν ο πρωτότοκος του Ιακώβ και της Λείας. Ο Ρουβήν αναφέρεται και στη συνέχεια της ιστορίας του Ισραήλ, ιδιαίτερα στη διαθήκη του Ιακώβ, όπου κατατάσσεται πρώτος μεταξύ των υιών του Ιακώβ.

in_latin.name: Ruben
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ruben derivatur ex hebraeo רובן, quod interpretatur 'ecce filius Dei vidit'. Ruben fuit primogenitus Iacobi et Liae, et nomen eius datum est ab ipsa Lia, quae dixit: 'Quia vidit Dominus afflictionem meam, quia non addidit mihi maritus meus filios' (Genesis 29, 32-33). Nomen Ruben etiam in Novo Testamento non invenitur, sed est nomen traditionis christianae antiquae.

in_english.name: Ruben
in_english.meaning: Behold, a son of God has seen or God has seen
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ruben originates from the Hebrew name רובן (Ruben), which means 'Behold, a son of God has seen' or 'God has seen'. Ruben was the firstborn son of Jacob and Leah, as recorded in the book of Genesis. The name was given by Leah, expressing her gratitude that God had seen her affliction and provided her with a son. Throughout Christian tradition, Ruben symbolizes leadership and divine favor. The name carries spiritual significance, reflecting God's awareness and providence.

data.spiritual_significance: Ruben signifies leadership and protection. As the eldest son of Jacob, he held a significant role among his brothers and played a crucial part in their survival during the famine. His actions demonstrate bravery, care, and responsibility, making Ruben an inspiring name for those called to lead and protect others spiritually or otherwise.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ruben, derived from the Hebrew word for "son," symbolizes the promise of new life and inheritance, reflecting God's covenant love. In Christian tradition, it also represents the tender and strong bond between father and firstborn son.
